neighbours.label: the cause in an enabling statement, just before the enabled outcome: 'X gave Y much more flexibility', 'sufficient cover', 'X made Y possible' (output promotes allow/enable)
fire: The invention of the printing press gave scholars much wider access to books.
New lightweight alloys made longer flights possible for small aircraft.
The thick fog gave the escaping prisoners sufficient cover to reach the river.
Cheap broadband lets rural businesses compete with firms in large cities.
The extra funding gave the lab much more freedom in choosing projects.
Steel frames made taller buildings feasible in crowded downtown areas.
A larger battery enables the drone to stay airborne for an hour.
Online banking makes paying bills especially convenient for busy parents.
quiet: The invention of the printing press is usually dated to the fifteenth century.
New lightweight alloys were displayed at the aviation fair last spring.
The thick fog rolled over the valley before the prisoners woke up.
Cheap broadband is still rare in many rural parts of the region.
The extra funding was announced by the dean in a short email.
Steel frames are painted grey before they leave the factory.
A larger battery weighs more and costs about twenty dollars extra.
Online banking was introduced by the local credit union in 2003.
